solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Gloomy doctor has run around with outbreak of flu

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is the usual crossword doctor

indicators.note: around suggests the letters of run being turned about into a new order
an outbreak scatters things, so the letters of flu are jumbled

explanation.surface: A depressed doctor who has been rushing about during a flu epidemic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' and 'outbreak of' each scramble only the short word beside them, giving URN and FUL; the doctor is the medical officer, a crossword staple.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorrowful and gloomy are close synonyms describing a dismal, mourning mood.

clue.text: He may well appeal to the public

definitions.text: He may well appeal to the public

parts.words: He may well appeal to the public
parts.note: a public speaker makes appeals to a crowd as a matter of course

explanation.definitionFit: A public speaker is someone whose job is addressing and appealing to audiences.

clue.text: Mountains in cattle country

definitions.meaning: a chain of mountains, as in the Rocky Mountains ...
in the American West, open grazing land for herds

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a line of mountains and open grazing land where cattle roam.

clue.text: Thwart made of wood, entirely

parts.note: a forest is a large wood
all means wholly, entirely

explanation.surface: Someone foiled by an object made completely of timber.
explanation.definitionFit: To forestall someone is to prevent or thwart their action by getting in first.

clue.text: Restricted cover includes free time

indicators.note: includes means one piece holds another inside it

parts.note: a lid is a cover

indicators.note: free means the letters of time are loosed and rearranged

explanation.surface: An insurance policy with limited cover that still throws in some free time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free' looks like part of the insurance picture but signals the anagram MITE; 'includes' then sets it inside the cover.
explanation.definitionFit: Something limited is restricted or kept within bounds.

clue.text: One has gathered wood for burning

indicators.note: has gathered means the word One holds another piece within it

parts.note: fir is a softwood timber

explanation.surface: Someone who has collected some timber to make a fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Being alight or ablaze is to be burning.

clue.text: The gold edging makes this different

indicators.note: edging means the gold piece sits around the word The as a border

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: A gold trim makes something look distinctive.
explanation.walkthrough: In heraldry gold is called or; 'edging' says it splits to form a border round the word The.
explanation.definitionFit: Other and different both mean not the same as the one already mentioned.

clue.text: Action ended dispute

parts.note: fighting is military action
over means finished, ended

explanation.surface: The fighting stopped, yet the argument goes on.
explanation.definitionFit: To fight over something is to argue or contend about it, a phrasal verb meaning dispute.

clue.text: It's all round the town, of interest to motorists

definitions.text: It's all round the town, of interest to motorists

parts.words: It's all round the town, of interest to motorists
parts.note: reads like gossip spreading through town but describes a circular bypass road

explanation.definitionFit: A bypass road circling a town lets drivers avoid its centre.

clue.text: Ring master?

parts.note: not a circus ringmaster but the composer of the opera cycle known as the Ring

explanation.definitionFit: The German composer wrote Der Ring des Nibelungen, so he is master of the Ring.

clue.text: Many a creature's seen in a wood

indicators.note: seen in means one piece appears inside the other

parts.note: taken as written
a hog is a pig, a creature

explanation.surface: Lots of animals can be spotted in a forest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen in' places A plus the creature inside MANY, just after its first letter; the second 'a' is only a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Mahogany is a reddish-brown hardwood timber, a kind of wood.

clue.text: A few will have disturbed rest in part of south-west England

parts.note: some means a few

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of rest are shaken up

explanation.surface: A handful of holidaymakers will have their sleep interrupted in the West Country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges REST into RSET. Somerset is an English county in the south-west.
explanation.definitionFit: Somerset is a county in the south-west of England.

clue.text: About to get wrong answer

parts.note: re means about, concerning
a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: Someone is about to give an incorrect reply.
explanation.definitionFit: A retort is a sharp reply, an answer.

clue.text: Study clamour of birds in northern Europe?

parts.note: to scan is to study closely
din is noise, clamour
avian means relating to birds

explanation.surface: Researching birdsong in the far north of Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Scandinavian describes the region of Norway, Sweden and Denmark in northern Europe.

clue.text: Little inclination to cut number of candidates

parts.note: short means little in length
a list is a lean or tilt, as of a ship

explanation.surface: A slight lean is needed to trim the field of applicants.
explanation.definitionFit: To pare down a field of applicants to a select few is to shortlist them.

clue.text: End a Metro trip to see it?

definitions.text: End a Metro trip to see it?

indicators.note: trip means the letters of End a Metro stumble into a new order

explanation.surface: Get off the Paris underground to visit a sight.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: a Metro trip in Paris might end at the cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: Notre-Dame is the famous Paris cathedral, a sight reached by Metro.

clue.text: Right to get junior minister to foot the bill

indicators.note: in a down clue, to foot means one piece goes beneath the other

parts.note: AC, account, is a bill
a curate is an assistant clergyman, a junior minister of the church

explanation.surface: A junior government minister is right to pay the bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'junior minister' suggests politics but is a curate; 'foot the bill' places CURATE below AC.
explanation.definitionFit: Accurate means correct, right.

clue.text: The classroom is untidy — and he's responsible

indicators.note: untidy means the letters of The classroom are in disorder

explanation.surface: The classroom is a mess and a teacher is to blame.
explanation.definitionFit: A teacher is responsible for a class and its room.

clue.text: Mean to issue statement on time

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means one piece sits above the other

parts.note: to aver is to state firmly
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone intends to make an announcement promptly.
explanation.definitionFit: The mean of a set of numbers is its average.

clue.text: Control acceleration by gravity above Pole

parts.note: g is the physics symbol for acceleration due to gravity
over means above
N is the north pole

explanation.surface: Managing speed and gravity at the top of the world.
explanation.definitionFit: To govern is to rule or control.

clue.text: Fat goat?

definitions.meaning: a dairy fat spread on bread
one that butts with its head, as a goat does

explanation.definitionFit: Butter is a dairy fat, and a goat, which butts, is jokingly one who butts.

clue.text: River cut by river

parts.note: to hone is to sharpen a blade, loosely to give it a cutting edge

explanation.surface: One river crossed or carved through by another.
explanation.walkthrough: The Rhône is the great river of south-east France; 'cut' is a loose stand-in for hone, which really means sharpen, so the wordplay is a little generous.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rhône is a major European waterway flowing from Switzerland through Lyon to the Mediterranean.

clue.text: He works with a will

parts.note: not a keen worker but one who carries out the terms of a testament

explanation.definitionFit: The person named to carry out the instructions in someone's testament.

clue.text: American's boxing can set back fighting teams

indicators.note: boxing means the first piece encloses the second

parts.note: US is short for American

indicators.note: set back means the word for can is read from the end

parts.note: a tin is a can

explanation.surface: An American fighter boxing to set back rival squads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set back' turns the can into NIT, and 'boxing' puts that inside the American abbreviation; 'fighting' belongs to the definition, not the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Military units are groups of soldiers, fighting teams.

clue.text: Aim to ban corruption in Canadian province

indicators.note: corruption means the letters of Aim to ban are spoiled into a new order

explanation.surface: A campaign against graft in a Canadian region.
explanation.definitionFit: Manitoba is one of the prairie provinces of Canada.

clue.text: It's appeared a siren has been set off

indicators.note: set off means the letters of a siren are started into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An alarm went off, and so something has shown up.
explanation.definitionFit: To have arisen is to have come up or appeared.

clue.text: It's used for pounding with mortar

definitions.text: It's used for pounding with mortar

parts.words: It's used for pounding with mortar
parts.note: mortar suggests bricks, but here it is the bowl paired with a grinding tool

explanation.definitionFit: The club-shaped tool used with a mortar bowl to grind spices.

clue.text: Odds on getting good service

parts.note: evens are betting odds of one to one
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gambler backs a horse at even money and does well.
explanation.definitionFit: Evensong is the evening service of the Church of England.
